_note: Gates for tools/e2e/t49_matte_edge_gate.js, set at about 1.4x the values measured on the v0.89 shader (software GL, seeded synthetic scene, so deterministic). 'lowc' (person colour ~ wall colour) is held at the OLD shader's level: colour tricks must not make that case worse. Synthetic only. v0.90 adds dark, hair and motion scenes. These three are BASELINES (regression guards at ~1.4x measured), not quality targets: dark/motion are weak (alphaMAE 0.17-0.41 because a mask that is wrong by more than the colour edge can recover cannot be fixed by the shader) and hair strands are lost (0.065). Real fix = a better mask model, not more shader tricks.
